cost_cap.basis: 40 calls x worst-case (2k prompt+4096 completion) ~= $0.22 at frozen pricing (input $0.3/M, output $1.2/M); cap = 2x worst case, ~15x expected (~$0.03)
cost_cap.enforcement: external watchdog polls traces/ cumulative cost_usd from per-call usage; exceeding cap kills the driver process immediately; run recorded ABORTED_COST_CAP
cost_cap.anomaly_stop: driver assert-failure (HTTP non-2xx, transport error, served-model mismatch, truncation, missing usage) aborts the whole run immediately with exit 1; no partial scoring

retry_policy.restart: at most one restart, ONLY if 0 calls succeeded AND cause is environmental (DNS/connect refused); otherwise abort is final
retry_policy.proxy_fallback: single fallback with NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 + local proxy 127.0.0.1:10808 only under the same 0-calls condition

key_handling: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY from process env only; never logged, never written to any file; driver serializes request body without headers
native_reuse: 20x2 native receipts reused from committed validation/g5-hard-r1-native-2026-11-13/REAL_JS_NATIVE_UID65534.json (git blob d74a27c1c13f497a46fdec151c5f234efc88af2f); native NOT re-run

executor.role: independent non-Writer Source-First reviewer + real-run executor (R7 session)
